chore(docs): delete the iframe demo shell; one demo list read off examples/ (rich-demos-k78j.7qo)

Every demo runs in its card, so the vite demo bundle, demos:build, the
generated demos.json, the _browser-shell templates, the browser-terminal-host
harness and the iframe branches of the demo page and e2e spec go. demoNames()
in docs/.vitepress/demo-entry.ts is the one list the sidebar, the demo routes,
the Demos index (demos.data.ts) and the e2e gate read. XTERM moves beside the
live terminal that loads it.

feat(examples): terminal-host demo replaces the BrowserTerminalHost harness (rich-demos-k78j.9yz) (#371)

* feat(examples): terminal-host demo replaces the BrowserTerminalHost harness (rich-demos-k78j.9yz)

The harness exercised BrowserTerminalHost, which the card now builds for every
program. terminal-host is the same contract as a demo: a key inspector written
against TerminalHost alone, run on NodeTerminalHost by main.ts (card and
npm run terminal-host) and on BrowserTerminalHost by embed.ts, which a unit
test drives on a fake xterm. The harness's own files stay until 7qo: they are
the iframe bundler's last input, and removing them breaks demos:build.

* fix(examples): terminal-host escapes every control byte, quits mid-read, hands back cooked mode on any exit (rich-demos-k78j.9yz)

* fix(examples): terminal-host shows bytes that are not UTF-8 as \xNN, not U+FFFD (rich-demos-k78j.9yz)
